description: Use this when someone is looking for an office, desks for a team or a team space, before searching or shortlisting. Pass what the person already said; returns the questions still open (in a broker's order, with the city's real districts) and when to search. Call it again as answers come in. Not for day passes or meeting rooms.

alternatives.description: What else they consider: a traditional lease, a sublease, staying, going remote, another broker, spaces asked directly.

area.description: Districts, a station or street they named.

budget_monthly_eur.description: Total per month for the team.

context.description: Stage, what matters most, current space.

current_lease_end.description: When their current lease ends, YYYY-MM-DD.

decision.description: Who decides and by when: a role (themselves, founder, CFO, board, parent company), never a person's name, plus the date if they named one.

format.description: private_room = a room with a door.

name: start_office_brief
title: Start an office brief
